items.name: Claude Duet
items.summary: Anthropic's new standalone proactive AI agent, built on Opus 5.5, that monitors connected apps, sends a morning brief, and completes tasks in its own cloud VM — its answer to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots. Available as a waitlisted research preview for US Pro/Max subscribers on iOS, Android and claude.ai.

items.name: Flint (Recursive)
items.summary: The first released model from Richard Socher's Recursive lab, a step toward 'recursively self-improving superintelligence' built with its AI-driven Eureka Machine research loop. A local-first model that hits ~150 tokens/sec on personal hardware like Apple silicon Macs and the RTX Spark laptop.

items.name: Granite Speech 5.0
items.summary: IBM's refreshed open-weight speech AI family (Apache 2.0): a new 2B model for high-accuracy transcription and translation, an updated ultra-fast 470M TurboCTC for on-device use, and updated weights for multi-speaker recordings with speaker attribution — all with native Transformers support.

items.name: Nuix Neo AI Agent
items.summary: An agentic AI layer for Nuix Neo's investigative analytics platform that answers plain-language questions, links every answer to its source, and records its full reasoning steps with a built-in audit trail — designed to be defensible in court for legal, regulatory and law-enforcement matters.

items.name: FLUX 3 Max
items.summary: fal Research and Black Forest Labs' post-trained video model that renders a 10-second clip in ~12 seconds — about 22x faster than Seedance 2.5 at the same quality tier — launched at $0.0425/sec (75% off through November 7) exclusively through fal's API.
